description: This file defines the internal hash policy traits for the Abseil C++ library, specifically for hash table implementations. It includes template structures and functions for managing hash table slots, keys, and iterators, and handles key access and memory usage policies.

classes.name: hash_policy_traits
classes.description: Template struct defining hash table slot management policies, key access, and iterator behavior based on a given Policy class.

classes.name: ReturnKey
classes.description: Nested struct within hash_policy_traits providing key access logic, including support for C++17 std::launder.

methods.name: space_used
methods.description: Returns the memory used by a hash slot.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a functor to the key of an element, supporting various constructor and initializer scenarios.

methods.name: mutable_key
methods.description: Retrieves a mutable reference to the key portion of a hash slot.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Retrieves the value portion of an element, used in map implementations.
